summary: Validated the two bug fixes for 9x Security: (A) tailgating de-dup — engine pytest suites pass 55/55 incl. the new test_engine_tailgating_cars_both_counted and the other listed scenario tests; (B) login 401 handling — wrong credential on /api/login surfaces 'Galat username ya password.' instead of session-expiry, correct admin/9xsecurity login returns a token with must_change_password=true, bad X-Auth-Token on /api/state returns 401. Backend regression (service_api/worker_restart/rtsp_discover/net_scan) passes 36/36. Frontend Playwright flow confirmed: wrong-password shows the correct error in [data-testid=login-error] and the login-form remains visible (no bounce); correct login triggers the force-change-form, setting Temp123456 lands on the dashboard app shell; admin password was restored to '9xsecurity' via POST /api/settings and default login verified (HTTP 200).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js login-path 401 branch cleanly separates credential errors from session expiry — good narrow fix.

engine _duplicate_reason now relies on track identity (alive-track overlap, aged-out lost-box IoU>0.3, or appeared-at-line inside aged-out box) — removes the fragile pure-timing flicker rule that caused the tailgating drop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Engine runs on 127.0.0.1:8971 (nohup python service.py). Button testid is 'login-btn' (not 'login-submit'). Force-change-form appears on first login with the default seed password; always restore password via POST /api/settings {new_password:'9xsecurity'} with a fresh token before finishing.
rca of the issue: Fix verified end-to-end; tailgating scenario in test_engine_tailgating_cars_both_counted confirms two distinct tracks crossing the same line within <2.5s now both emit events.
